metadata.title: LipoKG: A Knowledge Graph Dataset for Lipoprotein Metabolism Research
metadata.description: A comprehensive FAIR-compliant knowledge graph integrating multi-source data for lipoprotein metabolism research. This dataset combines protein-protein interactions (STRING v12.0), genetic variants (ClinVar), disease associations (DisGeNET, OMIM, GLGC 2021, Orphanet), and pathway information (KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways) into a unified graph structure. The knowledge graph contains 6,050 core nodes and 36,404 core edges (extended Neo4j schema: 6,475 nodes, 37,177 edges), with 78.9% coverage of reference lipoprotein metabolism genes across three pathway databases. Independent validation achieves 92.3% coverage of GO:0042157 (lipoprotein metabolic process). This dataset is designed to support systematic knowledge gap discovery, drug repurposing research, and precision medicine applications in cardiovascular disease. This version (1.2.0) additionally includes the six extended-schema CSV exports under data/extended/, a per-file inventory with byte sizes and row counts (Table S25), and a gene-level annotation coverage matrix (Table S24) characterising how many genes carry annotation in each layer beyond STRING connectivity: of the 1,852 proteins in the interaction graph, 114 (6.2%) carry at least one additional layer and 1,738 (93.8%) are represented by STRING edges only.

files.description: Comprehensive documentation including dataset description, schema, usage examples, and citation information
Quick start guide for using LipoKG with Neo4j and Python
Detailed schema documentation describing node types, relationship types, and data model
BioLinkML-compliant schema definition file
Example Cypher queries for common use cases
Tutorial demonstrating four real-world use cases
1,852 protein nodes from STRING database with Ensembl IDs and descriptions
31,878 protein-protein interaction edges from STRING with confidence scores
4,042 ClinVar variant nodes with clinical significance information (3-step filtered)
4,042 variant-gene relationship edges from ClinVar
27 disease nodes related to lipoprotein metabolism with MONDO IDs
238 gene-disease association edges from DisGeNET (35), OMIM (20), GLGC 2021 (111), Orphanet (50), and expert curation (22)
57 molecule nodes including drugs and metabolites relevant to lipoprotein metabolism
7 lipoprotein particle nodes (CM, VLDL, IDL, LDL, HDL, Lp(a), Chylomicron Remnant)
48 protein-particle composition edges (COMPONENT_OF)
8 protein-particle assembly relationship edges (ASSEMBLED_BY)
23 enzyme-particle modification edges (MODIFIES)
52 gene nodes from KEGG pathway hsa04979
15 pathway nodes from KEGG, Reactome, and WikiPathways
246 gene-pathway membership edges
Comprehensive graph statistics in JSON format
Drug-target relationships (29 TARGETS edges)
Drug-disease relationships (20 TREATS edges)
Enzyme-substrate relationships (59 SUBSTRATE_OF edges)
Variant-gene effect relationships (AFFECTS_GENE edges)
Merged particle-protein mapping (79 relationships)
Protein isoform relationships (12 ISOFORM_OF edges)
